report.summary: No evidence-supported defects found. The original document copies match the candidate documents by SHA-256. lib.py implements AC1 with exact built-in-int rejection, positive-boundary enforcement, and identity-preserving return; AC2 accepts only exact built-in lists, delegates every element to the scalar validator, preserves order and caller input, returns a new list including for empty input, and naturally propagates the first validation exception without returning partial output. Tests cover normal, boundary, error, ordering, distinct-output, preservation, list-subclass, and first-invalid-element paths. Direct read-only execution of the required suite passed all 9 tests. Supplied receipts verify meaningful test-first RED and subsequent GREEN for tasks 1.1 and 1.2, plus passing final green and gate runs at the exact input snapshot. The cumulative changes are limited to the two required implementations and their tests; no dependency, network, logging, persistence, CLI, mutation, security, concurrency, performance, or compatibility concern was identified.
